services.title: Our Thermal Mapping Service
services.statement: PMQ SERVICES carries out temperature and humidity mapping services to evaluate the homogeneity of environmental conditions, identify critical zones, and verify storage compliance with regulatory and normative requirements.
services.simulator_desc: Hover or touch the storage chamber to analyze thermal distribution, detect gradients, and verify critical hotspots.

process.title: 9-Step Mapping Service Workflow
process.subtitle: A rigorous, standardized metrological process designed for regulatory audit readiness.
process.step1: Study of the configuration and volume of the area to be mapped
process.step2: Definition of the mapping protocol and sensor positioning plan
process.step3: Deployment of measurement instruments with metrological traceability
process.step4: Continuous recording of temperature and relative humidity
process.step5: Identification of hot spots and cold spots
process.step6: Analysis of minimum, maximum, and average values
process.step7: Homogeneity and stability assessment of storage conditions
process.step8: Identification of potential critical risk zones
process.step9: Preparation of a comprehensive, compliant mapping report

domains.title: Intervention Areas & Qualified Storage Chambers
domains.subtitle: On-site industrial mapping across all thermal volumes and controlled enclosures.
domains.item1_desc: Strict monitoring of raw materials, chemical inputs, and products sensitive to environmental variations.
domains.item2_desc: Ensuring regulatory compliance prior to market distribution and batch release.
domains.item3_desc: Qualification of high-bay storage facilities, pallet racking, and circulation corridors.
domains.item4_desc: 3D multi-point mapping of positive and negative cold chambers per WHO guidelines.
domains.item5_desc: Characterization of laboratory equipment, bioreagents, and ultra-low temperature freezers.
domains.item6_desc: Securing reference batches, retention samples, and stability library conditions.
domains.item7_desc: Monitoring airflow dynamics, quarantine areas, and thermal airlocks.

standards.title: Normative References & Regulatory Framework
standards.intro: Services are performed in accordance with applicable ANPP regulatory requirements and in reference to current standards and guidelines:
standards.ref1_desc: Measurement of air humidity and characterization of thermal and climatic chambers.
standards.ref2_desc: World Health Organization technical supplement on temperature mapping of storage areas.
standards.ref3_desc: International recommendations on the qualification of temperature-controlled storage facilities.
standards.ref4_desc: Requirements applicable to storage conditions for sensitive, healthcare, and industrial products.
